site.title: 3D Models
site.description: Free 3D-printable models. Preview them in 3D, customize them right in the browser, and download STL or 3MF files.

models.title: Reading Tracker Sign
models.description:
An arched sign for keeping count of the books and mangas you've read, with swappable number tiles that hang on pegs. It slots into a base with two drawers.

Use the customizer to pick the version (books and manga, or books only), the theme, the title and the sizes. Then choose a part, and download it as STL or 3MF. The 3MF keeps each colour as a separate part, ready for a multi-colour printer.

print.Single-colour printer: Change filament at the top of the panel (4 mm with default settings)
print.Large panel: Use the panel_bottom, panel_top and splice_plate parts if it doesn't fit your bed
